consequence.statement: Values populated in the runtime config file's `default` block are no longer honoured because the block was removed; defaults must be set in `operational_config`.
consequence.remediation: Move default values into the top-level `operational_config` in the standard Loki config.

assertion.statement: The `default` block of the runtime overrides config file (added in 2.9) was removed; set default values in the top-level `operational_config` of the standard Loki config instead.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Runtime config file contents are not visible as a typed input; text says it affects only those with a runtime config file whose `default` block is populated.
